<cardId>.title: string
<cardId>.alertType: Card fraud | Account takeover | Scam (APP) | Identity fraud | Money mule | First-party fraud

rules: columns are exactly col-alert, col-review, col-investigation, col-verification, col-decision, in that order
column titles are free text (stages can be renamed)
every card id in cards appears in exactly one column's cardIds, and every cardIds entry exists in cards
each card's id matches its key in cards
alertType and risk are required and must be one of the listed values
accountLast4 is exactly 4 digits (full account numbers are never stored)
archivedAt is optional (null or missing = active). Archived cards stay in their column's cardIds and are hidden on the board

card-1.title: Velocity rule: 14 card txns in 10 min
card-1.details: Rule engine flagged rapid low-value card-not-present purchases. Auto-hold placed; assign to analyst queue by risk score.
